spans.s:
kaṭaka (EI 8, 17), the camp or capital.
 (SITI), a fortified place; a cantonment; a military camp.
 Cf. kaṭakaṃ kartavyam (LP), ‘an army should be sent [against one]’.
Kaṭak-ādhirāja (EI 4), same as Kaṭakarāja, etc.; a military officer in charge of the royal camp.
Kaṭakādhīśa (HD), same as Kaṭakarāja, etc.
Kaṭaka-nāyaka (EI 23), same as Kaṭakarāja, etc.
Kaṭakarāja (EI 9; HD), officer in charge of the royal camp; same as Kaṭakādhīśa, etc. Cf. Ep. Ind., Vol. IV, p. 309, note 1.
Kaṭaka-vārika (EI 30), probably, officials serving under the superintendent of the royal camp (Kaṭakarāja, etc.).
Kaṭakeśa (EI 29; HD), superintendent of the royal camp; same as Kaṭakarāja, etc. Cf. Ep. Ind., Vol. VII, p. 185.
ka-ṭa-pa-y-ādi (IE
; EI 33; IA 19, 24), a system of recording numbers.
kaṭī-sūtra (EI 16), an ornament.
kaṭṭaṇa (SITI), periodical presents made to superiors by their subordinates.
kaṭṭu-guttagai (ASLV), Tamil; a contract.

Kaṭuka (EI 13; HD), an official designation of uncertain import; explained as ‘a commander of the elephant force’ (Tripathi, History of Kanauj, p. 137); cf. Mahākaṭuka. See Ep. Ind., Vol XIII, p. 117.
kaṭumukha (EI 5), name given to a musical instrument.
kāṭci (SITI), Tamil; presents offered to a highly superior person at the time of meeting.
kāṭciy-ěrudu-kkāśu (SITI), Tamil; tax probably on bulls kept for show.
kāṭṭāl̤-kāśu (SITI), Tamil; tax of uncertain import.
kaṭṭaṇam (SITI), Tamil; periodical presents made to superiors by their subordinates.
kaṭṭ-āyam (SITI), Tamil-Sanskrit; consolidated amount payable for the minor taxes; also written as kaṇḍ-āyam; sometimes taken as the compulsory payment of certain dues.
kaṭṭu-kkuttagai (SITI), Tamil; rent fixed at the time of farming out the land; payment of consolidated rent.
kaṭṭumukkai (SITI), Tamil; ‘three handfuls in the bundle’; a contribution of three handfuls for every bundle of paddy stalks harvested, which were payable to the temples; cf. arimukkai.
